description: FROZEN identity of the ONE approved ADR-0043 validation-box deploy object. The hardened provisioner reads every identity from here — bucket, key, S3 object VersionId, sha256, byte size, and the two provenance commits. Runtime environment values are permitted ONLY as assertions that must equal these exactly; the provisioner refuses (before contacting S3) on any mismatch. Changing the approved object requires editing this committed manifest under review. This revision advances the deploy to bab4ce1, the squash merge of PR #499 and the reviewed tree carrying the three blocking Phase-0 PRs: #495 (day-change provenance, migration c1f4a7d2e8b3), #498 (the harness measures the session loss against the immutable baseline or refuses), and #499 (governed operator tooling including the structurally account-3-scoped sync). THE ADR-0043 IMPLEMENTATION BASELINE ADVANCES to the #498 merge commit 1773707700abaac981a44f6ed25b740909f5646f — that advance IS the substance of this review. #498 changes the governed path apps/backend/scripts/adr0043_canary_lib.py, so build-deploy-archive.sh refuses (exit 3) against the previous baseline 4e63dc034efbdff50dc605ccd2aec440ce8a94f4 (#480): deploying the reviewed #498 correction necessarily moves the baseline that pins the governed ADR-0043 code. Against 1773707 the governed-path delta is empty and governed_paths_match is true, so the ENFORCE box still runs exactly the reviewed loss-control/settlement code. The remaining delta present in the deploy is exactly the six new #499 operator-tooling files (adr0043_reachability.py, adr0043_scoped_sync.py, adr0043_session_open.py and their three test modules); nothing is excluded from the deploy. ARTIFACT REBUILT LF-CLEAN 2026-07-28: the first archive of this same commit (sha 7bd93d0d…) was built on a machine with core.autocrlf=true, so git archive emitted CRLF for .py files (which carry no explicit eol attribute; *.sh was unaffected because .gitattributes pins it to eol=lf). Content was identical — CR-stripped hashes matched the blobs — but byte equality against the merged git blobs was impossible, which would have defeated the manual verification chain that stands in for GOVERNED_PATHS coverage, and it silently changed deployed artifact form (the previously deployed tree has LF .py). Rebuilt with core.autocrlf=false and core.eol=lf; the archive is now byte-identical to the reviewed tree for 1851/1851 files, the sole exception being this manifest itself, which correctly carries bab4ce1's version because #531 updated it after that commit. CAVEAT recorded deliberately: those three new operator tools are NOT members of the builder's GOVERNED_PATHS set, so their byte identity is not enforced by the governed-path invariant. For this deploy they are verified manually against the merged blobs (git blob, host file, container-mounted file); extending GOVERNED_PATHS to cover them is a follow-up.
